snippet.title: Ardena | Official Reveal Trailer | Steam (PC)
snippet.description:
AVAILABLE NOW ON STEAM!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3441000/Ardena/

Ardena is a first-person survival horror game where your only light is a dwindling campfire. Gather wood to keep it burning, uncover chilling clues about you and your location, and find a way to escape the mysterious forest—before she finds you.

#firstperson #survivalgame #horror 

Join us on Instagram : https://instagram.com/rrstud.io
Join our Discord : https://discord.gg/sqe4E3RYsQ

We invite the community to join our dedicated Discord server , where they can engage directly with the development team. Members will have the opportunity to follow the game's progress in real time, access exclusive behind-the-scenes content, and provide invaluable feedback based on their gameplay experiences. Their insights will play a crucial role in shaping the final version of the game.
